title: Advancement or Acceleration? How Data Curation Improves LLM Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.36983v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While data curation is widely credited with improving large language model training, a basic question remains unresolved: does curation expand what a model can ultimately learn, or merely reach the same solution faster? In this paper, we formalize this distinction between advancement (improving the attainable performance) and acceleration (reaching the same performance with less data). Through an analytic characterization and real-world LLM experiments, we show that advancement requires a correctable train-target gap. When the baseline training and target objectives coincide, no curation policy improves the endpoint, although curation may still accelerate training. This reframes advancement as a property of the curation task rather than the curation method. translated_title: 是提升还是加速？数据筛选如何改进大语言模型训练
translated_abstract: 虽然数据筛选被广泛认为能改善大语言模型的训练，但一个基本问题仍未解决：数据筛选究竟扩展了模型最终能够学习到的能力上限，还是仅仅让模型更快地达到相同的解？在本文中，我们形式化地区分了“提升”（advancement，即改善模型可达到的性能）与“加速”（acceleration，即用更少的数据达到相同性能）这两个概念。通过分析性刻画和真实世界的大语言模型实验，我们证明提升需要存在一个可纠正的训练-目标差距。当基线训练与目标相一致时，没有任何筛选策略能够改善最终训练结果，尽管数据筛选仍然可能加速训练过程。这将“提升”重新定义为筛选任务本身的属性，而非筛选方法的属性。在常见的以差距为中心的数据混合与选择视角下，我们将该条件操作化为Δ-测试，即未筛选基线的训练……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文形式化区分了数据筛选对LLM训练的“提升”（扩展模型最终可达到的性能）与“加速”（用更少数据达到相同性能），证明只有当训练与目标之间存在可纠正的差距时筛选才能带来提升，并提出可观测的Δ-测试来检验该条件。
en_tdlr: This paper formally distinguishes "advancement" (expanding the attainable performance) from "acceleration" (reaching the same performance with less data) in LLM data curation, proving that advancement requires a correctable train-target gap and operationalizing this condition as an observable Δ-test.
